layering.description: backend/src/types/ imports nothing from backend/src/config/, backend/src/repositories/, backend/src/services/, backend/src/api/, or any UI/frontend code -- Types is Layer 1, the lowest layer, per .claude/architecture.md. Verified by backend/tests/architecture/test_layer_imports.py.

typing.description: Every monetary field on Claim, Assessment, and Settlement (claim_amount, sum_insured, deductible, co_pay, payable_amount, payout_amount) is declared as decimal.Decimal, never float (NFR-01, E1-S1 AC5). Full type hints on every public function/dataclass field in backend/src/types/*.py. Verified by backend/tests/unit/types/test_models.py and mypy.

folder_structure.description: backend/src/types/ contains exactly enums.py, models.py, exceptions.py, state_machine.py, and __init__.py, matching specs/design/folder-structure.md.

state_mutation_gate.description: No `.status = ` assignment to a Claim-like object exists anywhere under backend/src/types/*.py except inside the transition() function in state_machine.py (E1-S2 AC3, NFR-08). Verified by backend/tests/architecture/test_state_mutation_gate.py.
